mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when INDPRO is above 110.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales and housing starts indicates increased demand, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply indicate an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during an expansion regime.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 5% during an expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP and housing starts indicates increased demand, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising during a late-cycle expansion regime.
